doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

title: Learning banjo in New Orleans from the Hanley brothers
summary: He started on ukulele then banjo with German teachers at Werlein's music store, took lessons from Dewey White, and later learned guitar in California.
